info.name: R-Stiker
info.summary: Sticker packs for Talk and Text
info.description:
Your own sticker packs in Nextcloud Talk and Text.
Pick a sticker and it is sent straight away as its own message. The message only carries a plain absolute link, so stickers also work in federated chats. All packs live in the app data folder - no database, no external service.
info.author: balco
